RULING: 值得 is zhí de, with 得 in the neutral tone (现代汉语词典: zhí·de). Explain claims 得 is dé and not dě; that teaches the wrong tone. No option offers neutral "zhí de", so zhí dé is the only workable key. Fix: replace key option with "zhí de" (keep distractors) and say 得 is 轻声, or drop item.

RULING: 便宜 (cheap) = pián yi, 宜 neutral tone (现汉 piányi). Distractor "pián yí" is non-standard. Explain correct. Keep.
Explain claims 斥 and 析 "都有「斤」". 斥 does not contain 斤; it only looks like 斤. Correct the shared-component claim.
Standard is 再接再厉 (现汉). 再接再励 is a common variant; acceptable as key but note it.
Explain claims 已 and 巳 are look-alikes "都有「己」". 已 and 巳 do not contain 己; they are only near-identical shapes (己 open, 已 half-closed, 巳 closed). Correct to 字形相近 without the shared-component claim.
Explain claims 己 and 巳 look like 已 "都有「己」". 已 and 巳 do not contain 己; just say they look alike (己 open, 已 half-closed, 巳 closed).

Explain says 办 (bàn) is "neither close in sound nor shape" to 辨 (biàn). bàn vs biàn differ only by the medial i, so they are close in sound. Correct to: close in sound, different in shape. Answer is fine.

小鸟高兴得在树上唱歌 is grammatical: 得 + a result clause (cf. 高兴得跳起来). Key 地 is the intended manner reading, but 得 is also defensible, so two particles work. Drop or rewrite, e.g. "小鸟高兴＿唱着歌" with 得 impossible, or use a stem where only 地 fits (e.g. 小鸟快乐地唱歌 with the next clause).
Explain claims 自 and 曰 look like 白 and "都有「白」". Only 百 contains 白; 自 and 曰 do not. Correct to: 自 and 曰 look similar to 白 (share a box shape) but do not contain it.
